visualCharacteristics.purpose: data table comparing products or listing forms, with links in cells and sortable columns

contentPattern.structure: one row per table row; the first row is the header. Cells may hold links and line breaks. Click a header to sort by that column. The extra no-header option (not in the catalog) skips the header row

reuseGuidance: Use for tabular data. Pair with list-filter or forms-finder above it for filtering. Row selection checkboxes and email actions from the source are not reproduced.
decisions: Source per-row checkboxes, email icons and state pop-overs are app behaviour and are not reproduced; column sorting is implemented client-side.
